author: rApq
content: INHERITED OBLIGATION from REQ-5 (#327, the bridge — option B): REQ-5 proved only the STRUCTURAL/skeleton soundness layer (T1-S strat_ref_sound: the encoder transcribes the quantifier+boolean skeleton faithfully, PARAMETRIC in an atom oracle q : Atom -> Bool — see lean/Thermite/Strat/Soundness.lean + fdenote in Nnf.lean). Atoms are NOT interpreted there (read by q; quantifiers range over an abstract finite dom, sorts erased). Therefore REQ-8 OWNS THE ATOM-GROUNDING: the faithfulness track (T2-S strat_lowering_faithful) + two-phase TV must instantiate the oracle q to the REAL v1/program atom semantics (qfree atoms -> Thermite.denote; Read/Cast/Len/rel -> their actual theory) and validate the production lowering against the reference encoder at the atom level. Until this loop is closed, cage L4 is structural-only. The spine's sdenote (REQ-1, 'QFree atoms defer to v1 denotation') is the natural concrete q to specialize the structural result to. CONSUMER NOTE: REQ-9's G2 trust: flip MUST gate on this grounding being closed, else the flipped cert over-claims (attests 'structurally encoded' not 'proven over source meaning'). Operate on Thermite.Strat.Cls.Frm (the classifier syntax), per the two-syntax architecture (.design/stage2-stratified-cage.md REQ-3/4/5 notes).
